notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet T1-SA26: ROAD PLANT 160 E baseline 260, 1510 overall (145 margins); second line baseline 500 (240 pitch, 100 below): NEXT 160 E (590) + 120 + distance numerals 160 E ('varies', dashed box) + 70 + km 135 E lower case (235), the numerals centred in the sheet's dashed box. Generated at 1, 2, 3, 5 and 10 km (not confirmed against SA practice). Layout: 1800 x 600, yellow, R0, black border 25, no edge strip. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): ROAD 160 E top 100 x 143-775 (631); PLANT 160 E top 100 x 902-1656 (754); {km} 160 E centred in the sheet's numeral box x 1014-1185; NEXT 160 E top 340 x 304-894 (589); km 135 E top 366 x 1255-1491 (236).
